result.description: A fictional 55-inch ultra-widescreen OLED display designed for cinema-style desktop setups, gallery installations, and immersive command rooms. It features a 5120x2160 native resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, HDR support, and a matte anti-glare panel with 99% DCI-P3 coverage. Connectivity includes two HDMI 2.1 ports, one DisplayPort 1.4, USB-C with 90W power delivery, and an integrated USB hub for peripherals.
result.title: Nimbus Arc 55Q OLED Monitor
